components.title: Kale sauce
ingredients: chili oil or clabbering chilies or red pepper flakes
steps: Boil water and season with salt. Add kale and cook until it starts to wet.
Add to ice water. Move it around cool it down squeeze out all the water.
Add kale to a blender with olive oil Parmesan cheese garlic salt and chili oil or clabbering chilies or red pepper flakes. Blend till smooth.
Add to a pan heat up. Boil pasta add pasta to the sauce mix with 1 tablespoon of cubed butter cold butter until glossy.
Top with kale chips and Parmesan crisp.

components.title: Parmesan crisp
steps: Take a baking sheet, put a piece of parchment paper on it and shaving fresh Parmesan on it.
Cook in the oven for about five minutes until crispy.

components.title: Kale chips
steps: Take some kale top with some olive oil, salt and pepper put in the oven till crispy.
